title: Development and validation of a method for quantitative determination of the genotoxic impurity diethyl sulfate in pitolisant hydrochloride via high-performance liquid chromatography
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16125-16133
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01217A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Santosh Bhagwat, Prakash Patil, Ramdas Pawar, Santosh Shinde, Dinesh Amalnerkar, Dnyaneshwar Shinde
Diethyl sulfate, a carcinogenic by-product in pitolisant hydrochloride synthesis, is converted to ethoxybenzene using sodium phenoxide, enabling its quantification by HPLC-UV to help minimize risk in the drug substance.
